_meta.name: Explainer-reel style spec v2 (presenter avatar + UI-card scenes) — Blue / Yellow / Black
_meta.purpose: Describes the look, motion language and scene flow of a vertical explainer reel so an LLM can build a Remotion project with any avatar, theme and topic. Keep the STRUCTURE and MOTION; swap BRAND, AVATAR and CONTENT.
_meta.how_to_use: Replace every value under `brand` and `content`. Do not change `layout`, `motion`, `components` or `scene_grammar` unless asked.
_meta.palette_logic: Blue = text highlights, lines, cursor, links. Yellow = filled shapes (ticks, badges, chips, selected states) always with BLACK text/icons on top. Black/navy = dark cards and headline ink.

format.audio: voiceover track drives timing; each caption chunk is one scene beat

brand.wordmark_style: lowercase, geometric sans, ~46px at 1080w, ink color, small yellow dot after the last letter
color_rules: Headline keyword highlight = accent_blue (yellow text on off-white is unreadable)
Anything FILLED and small (check circles, badges, chips, selected folder, progress bar) = accent_yellow with on_yellow content
On dark cards: placeholders/highlights = accent_yellow tinted chip, Copy chip = accent_yellow
Never use blue and yellow as adjacent flat fills without a black or white separator

fonts.headline: Space Grotesk (or similar neutral grotesk), weight 700, tracking -0.02em. For other scripts use a matching bold font with same sizing.
fonts.eyebrow: JetBrains Mono, weight 400, lowercase, color muted_text

avatar.description: Flat-vector half-cartoon presenter, full body, standing, front-facing. One SVG, viewBox 0 0 400 600. Outfit colors from palette: black top, blue accent detail, yellow small accessory.

layout._note: Percentages of the 9:16 frame. Same skeleton on EVERY scene.

eyebrow.style: mono, ~26px@1080, lowercase, prefixed with '// ', pattern '// step N · topic'

headline.reveal: word-by-word, each word fades in + rises ~14px over 6 frames, staggered to voiceover. Unspoken words hidden (or 12% opacity).

hero_zone.note: One hero card at a time, centered, ~84-90% of width.

avatar.z_order: above background; hero card never overlaps the head

wordmark.present_on: all scenes except final CTA, where it becomes large and centered

background.type: soft multi-blob gradient on cool off-white
layers: radial blob bg_blob_top_left, ~60% frame width, top-left, blurred, 75% opacity
radial blob bg_blob_mid_right, ~50% width, mid-right, 55% opacity
radial glow bg_glow_bottom behind avatar, ellipse 80% wide, bottom-center (the warm yellow halo)
background.particles: optional: a few tiny yellow dots floating up on emphasis beats (success, reveal)

springs.check_pop: scale 0→1.25→1 over 10 frames when a checkbox completes

motion.scene_transition: No hard cuts. Outgoing hero card blurs and fades while eyebrow/headline change; incoming card springs in 6-10 frames after the first headline word.
motion.headline_swap: Old headline fades out (4 frames), new headline words reveal one by one.
avatar_motion: pose changes ease-out cubic over ~14 frames
pose chosen per beat — see avatar_poses
motion.cursor: Black-outlined white arrow cursor glides along a bezier path to a target, then clicks: an accent_blue ring expands from the tip (scale 0.6→1.6, opacity .5→0, 12 frames) and the target gets hover/selected state.
motion.typing: Terminal/prompt text types at ~35 chars/sec with a block caret (accent_yellow) blinking every 15 frames.
motion.progress: Checklist items complete sequentially (empty circle → yellow filled circle with black tick) ~12 frames apart; optional thin yellow progress bar on a blue-soft track.

avatar_poses.idle: arms relaxed — default while a card is being read
avatar_poses.talk: both forearms slightly raised outward — explanatory beats
avatar_poses.point: L arm raised, index finger visible — when headline names a thing on the card, or says 'first / next / step N'
avatar_poses.wave: R arm raised and waving — ONLY hook (first 1-2s) and final CTA
avatar_poses.rule_of_thumb: Change pose every 2-4s; never hold one >5s. point ~40%, idle ~40%, talk ~15%, wave only start/end.

components._note: Build each once as a React component. All cards: white bg, radius 28px@1080, shadow (0 24px 60px rgba(10,12,20,.10)), 1px card_border.
components.StepPill: Black rounded-full pill, white text 'Step N · Topic', small yellow dot on the left. Appears alone first on a new step, then the real UI scene fades in.
components.ChecklistCard: White card. Small-caps title ('7 STEPS') then rows: numbered black circle OR empty/yellow-filled circle + label (left) + optional muted right-aligned hint. Used for overview AND progress.
components.TriCard: Three small white square cards in a row, each with an icon and bold title + muted subtitle; pop in with 5-frame stagger. Icon tile background = accent_blue_soft, icon stroke = accent_blue.
components.FileExplorerCard: Fake OS file window: three grey dots, centered title, breadcrumb bar, toolbar (black '+ New' button, ghost Cut/Copy/Paste), then pale-blue folder icons with labels. Selected folder turns solid accent_yellow with black outlined label.
components.DarkPromptCard: dark_card_bg, mono text, small uppercase header ('PROMPT 1 · SETUP') left and a yellow 'Copy' chip (black text) right. Placeholders inside are inline yellow-tinted chips. Text types in.
components.ChatInputCard: White rounded input box with placeholder and a small model-selector chip bottom-right; round black send button with white arrow.
components.ModelPickerCard: Dropdown list: model names with muted tag on right; hovered row has soft blue tint; separator then 'Effort — High'.
components.BrowserErrorCard: Blurred/ghosted web page with a big translucent black circle-X (not red) over it — signals 'don't do it this way'.
components.TranscribeWaveCard: White card, header row (app icon + 'Transcribing · file.mov'), a blue waveform of ~60 animated vertical bars (active bars yellow), then timestamped caption lines.
components.BadgeCircle: Big yellow filled circle with black bold text ('3+' and 'reels minimum'), pops in with overshoot at a card corner.
components.BigCheck: Large yellow circle with black tick, scale-in with overshoot, blue + yellow particles bursting outward.
components.PhoneMockup: Black-bordered phone frame (radius ~48px) showing a result clip or doc; floating yellow chip(s) pop in beside it (e.g. 'Edited by Claude ✓'), plus dark chips for example change-requests.
components.CollageBackdrop: Hook only: 8-10 tilted white phone-cards in a loose fan, with a large dark terminal window on top.
components.PixelTitle: Retro dot-matrix pixel text in accent_yellow on dark terminal ('PRODUCT NAME' on two lines), blinking blue prompt line '> edit my reel' under it.
components.CTAPills: Two pills at bottom: black 'Follow @handle' (white text) and a white pill 'Comment' + yellow 'KEYWORD' chip with black text.
components.Wordmark: Brand text logo, bottom-right of avatar area, always visible except final CTA.

scene_grammar._note: Each beat = [eyebrow] + [headline reveal] + [hero card] + [avatar pose]. One beat ≈ 1.5-4s. Total ≈ 25-35 beats.

beat_template.headline: 3-8 words, voiceover-synced, keyword in accent_blue
beat_template.exit: card_out blur-fade when next beat's hero differs

step_structure: 1) StepPill alone with headline naming the step (0.5-1s)
2) The UI card that SHOWS the step, with cursor/typing/ticks animating the action (3-8s)
3) Optional second state of same card while headline updates
scene_grammar.pacing: Fast. New headline phrase every ~1.5-2.5s. Cards persist across 2-4 headline changes when the visual still applies.

flow.headline: Everyone's now doing X with [Tool]
flow.hero: CollageBackdrop + PixelTitle terminal (dark window, yellow pixel title, typing prompt line)
flow.notes: Collage = social proof. Yellow sparkles drift.

flow.headline: …so I'll show you exactly how, step by step
flow.hero: collage + terminal blur out; three ghosted chips 'Step 1? Step 2? Step 3?' float in then fade

flow.headline: I'll show how to set it up
flow.hero: ChecklistCard 'N STEPS' with numbered black circles; rows appear one by one (3 first, then all N)

flow.headline: Every prompt, skill and tool — all of it, free
flow.hero: single card 'Prompt · copy–paste' pops in, then TriCard of three: Prompt (copy · paste), Skill (your style), Tool (all free)

flow.headline: First, [Tool]
flow.hero: StepPill 'Step 1 · …' → BrowserErrorCard (big black X = wrong way) → app window with Chat/Code toggle and dropdown (Local / Cloud); cursor clicks 'Local'; small dark chip 'Tool can see your files'

flow.headline: Next, [Folder Name]. Raw, references, exports.
flow.hero: FileExplorerCard: Documents/Music/[Folder Name] — cursor selects the new folder; then card swaps to its inside with three subfolders appearing one by one: raw / references / exports, each with muted caption ('your clips', 'reels you like', 'finished edits')

flow.headline: Install these repos. One prompt does it all.
flow.hero: ChecklistCard-style 'GitHub repos' list (4 repos, mono name + grey description) → DarkPromptCard 'PROMPT 1 · SETUP' typing → ChatInputCard with cursor clicking send → ChecklistCard 'Tool · setting up your editor' with items ticking: dependency A ✓, B ✓, then C, D, E

flow.headline: Then, ServiceName. Create an API key. Paste it.
flow.hero: Fake settings page with 'API keys' header and '+ Create key' button → modal 'API key created ✓' with masked key and copy icon; cursor clicks → TranscribeWaveCard: animated waveform + timestamped lines

flow.headline: Teach [Tool] your style. Share three reels minimum.
flow.hero: ChatInputCard with typed chip 'Learn my editing style from these reels' → three thumbnail reel cards drop in → DarkPromptCard 'PROMPT 3 · LEARN MY STYLE' with reel URLs in yellow chips → BadgeCircle '3+ reels minimum' pops in → ChecklistCard 'Your style, broken down' ticking: Pacing, Hook, Captions, Graphics, Sound (muted right-aligned detail each)

flow.headline: Drop your raw videos in the raw folder.
flow.hero: FileExplorerCard with raw/references/exports; a small video-file card drags in with cursor and drops into 'raw' (caption changes to '1 video ✓'); dark 'Ctrl + V' key chip appears

flow.headline: Pick [Best Model]. Send the prompt. Skill does the work.
flow.hero: ModelPickerCard (cursor moves down list, lands on best model) above ChatInputCard → DarkPromptCard 'PROMPT 4 · EDIT' typing → ChecklistCard 'Tool · editing your reel' with yellow progress bar and ticks: Transcribed, Cut pauses + filler, Captions + keywords, Graphics + sound, Rendered

flow.headline: Done. Want changes? Just ask.
flow.hero: BigCheck with particle burst → PhoneMockup playing the final result, yellow chip 'Edited by Claude ✓', two dark chips with sample requests ('Make the captions bigger') that slide in and blur out

flow.headline: Free guide. Comment EDIT.
flow.hero: PhoneMockup showing the guide doc (steps list + 'What you need' table) with yellow chip '+ FREE guide'; guide scrolls slowly; CTAPills slide up at bottom

flow.headline: (none — replaced by big wordmark)
flow.hero: Big centered Wordmark (~160px), below it 'Comment KEYWORD for the free guide' with KEYWORD in accent_blue, small muted 'Follow @handle · site'. Blue and yellow background blobs intensify slightly.

caption_rules.voiceover_sync: Headline words appear on the frame the word is spoken (±2 frames). No voiceover yet: 3.5 words/second.
caption_rules.emphasis: Highlight in accent_blue the noun the viewer must remember (tool, folder, model, 'prompt', 'skill'). Max 2 highlighted words per headline.
caption_rules.length: Max 8 words per headline, max 2 lines.
caption_rules.style: Sentence case. No emoji. No outline/stroke. No background box.

do: Keep the same layout skeleton every scene (eyebrow, headline, hero card, avatar, wordmark)
Build fake-but-believable UI from HTML/CSS, not screenshots
Animate the ACTION on the card (cursor, typing, ticking)
Keep it light, airy, generous whitespace; blue for text accents, yellow for filled pops, black for weight
Avatar points at the card on key words; wave only at start/end
dont: No hard cuts, no flashy zooms, no heavy shadows, no neon gradients
No third accent color (no red, green, orange) — errors use black, success uses yellow
No yellow text on light backgrounds; no white text on yellow
No two hero cards on screen at once (except while one blurs out)
Don't cover the avatar's head with a card
No real brand screenshots unless the user supplies them

structure: Reel.tsx — <AbsoluteFill> with Background, then <Series>/<Sequence>s per flow item
Persistent layer (outside sequences): Background, AvatarRig, Wordmark, Headline (driven by captions array)
Per-scene layer: hero component inside <Sequence from durationInFrames>
data/script.ts — array of beats: { startFrame, endFrame, eyebrow, words:[{text,frame,accent?}], hero, pose }
theme.ts — export the `brand.colors` object; components read colors only from it
components/ — one file per entry in `components`
remotion_notes.avatar: Import { AvatarRig } from './AvatarRig' and pass a timeline from beats' pose + startFrame. AvatarRig is pure (useCurrentFrame only) for parallel rendering.
rules: Use useCurrentFrame/useVideoConfig/spring/interpolate only — NO CSS transitions, setTimeout, requestAnimationFrame or Math.random() at render time
Use seeded values for particles/waveforms (hash of index)
Audio: <Audio src={staticFile('voice.mp3')} /> and derive word frames from a transcript JSON when available
